name: panda-rigid
$comment: Franka Emika Panda, two layers. Robot (subsystem, signal ports only): the spatial multibond arm of panda-free (Gaz et al. 2019 feasible parameters) at the ready pose, and per joint a bond-graph drive: torque limit (87/12 N m), motor torque source tau/N, rotor inertia J_m (I), gear N = 100 (TF), elastic joint (C, R) with a torque sensor (De) on its 0-junction, Gaz friction (nonlinear R) on the link side, a 20-bit link-side encoder (Quantizer, 1 ms) and the joint rate; drive values other than the torque limits are assumptions (README). Firmware (1 kHz): PandaTrajectory (Cartesian flange waypoints, quintic rest-to-rest) -> PandaIK (He & Liu 2021 analytical IK, q7 fixed, branch from the measured q, holds the last solution and raises flag) -> PandaPD (PD + Gaz gravity and friction feedforward, torque limits). Rigid variant: the seven joints are Revolute3DRigid (the held directions are hard velocity constraints with Lagrange-multiplier reactions, so the link inertias are derivative-causal, W201 by design), and mtkcompile's index reduction keeps q and qdot per joint as the states (plan/MULTIBOND_PLAN.md section 5.7).
